statusLine.command: input=$(cat); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); dir=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); branch=$(git -C "$dir" --no-optional-locks symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || git -C "$dir" --no-optional-locks rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null); out="$model | $dir"; [ -n "$branch" ] && out="$out | $branch"; echo "$out"
